subject: Security snapshot & provisional attestation — SOC 2 Type II access request
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@medigen.com>, MediGen Procurement <procurement@medigen.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security snapshot & provisional attestation — SOC 2 Type II access request

Hi Emma / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side to keep the compliance thread moving:

Call recap:
- MediGen is evaluating Redwood for document parsing + clinical summarization in a US-only deployment, with HIPAA in-scope and potential EU residency requirements for a subset of telemetry.
- Procurement needs SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a bridge letter if report predates current quarter, and short-term attestation while audit artifacts are prepared.

What we can do this week (proposed):
1) Share SOC 2 Type II report and signed bridge letter (or provisional bridge template) within 48 hours.
2) Send an invite to our Trust portal (secure artifact access) so your security team can download reports and artifact snapshots (link / SFTP fallback included).
3) Kick off the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) — we can pre-populate common answers and push the spreadsheet for your procurement to review; target turnaround: 7 business days.

Questions for you to confirm:
- Confirm scope: is HIPAA required (yes per call) and do you need EU data residency for telemetry/logs or entire dataset?
- Preferred access method: Trust portal (web SSO) or temporary SFTP?

Next steps I’ll take after you confirm scope:
- Attach: bridge_letter_template.pdf (we’ll fill & sign), vsq_medigen.xlsx (pre-populated), trust-portal invite link.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate signatures and portal access once you confirm the scope above.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment stubs: bridge_letter_template.pdf (application/pdf); vsq_medigen.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); redwood_trustportal-invite.link

Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security snapshot & provisional attestation — SOC 2 Type II access request

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the clear recap — that timeline sounds reasonable. A few quick clarifications from our side before you send anything: 

1) Confirm we will receive the full SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and a signed bridge letter for the gap period. Procurement will accept a provisional attestation only if we can attach a signed bridge letter showing the remediation timeline.
2) For data residency: we require that PHI processing remains in the US; telemetry/metrics may be handled in EU if needed, but Procurement prefers US-only unless otherwise necessary.
3) For access method, procurement prefers web SSO to the Trust portal; SFTP is an allowable fallback.

If you can send the report + bridge letter and the Trust portal invite this week, we’ll route to security and compliance for intake. Also please confirm whether we need to sign an NDA or if the portal link is sufficient for embargoed report access.

Emma Jenkins
Head of Procurement, MediGen
emma.jenkins@medigen.com | +1 212-555-0199
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 12:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security snapshot & provisional attestation — SOC 2 Type II access request

Hi Emma — copying the specific artifacts and access notes you’ll want.

Short answers up front: yes on SOC 2 Type II PDF + signed bridge letter; yes on HIPAA coverage; primary processing in us-east-1; Trust portal (web SSO) is available immediately.

What we will provide (attachments / links):
- SOC_2_Type_II_Report_2024-10.pdf (final Type II report)
- Bridge_Letter_MediGen_2025-07.pdf (signed; provisional if audit window extends)
- Trust portal invite: https://trust.redwood.ai/invite/abcd1234 (SSO; expires in 10 days)
- VSQ: vsq_medigen.xlsx (pre-populated answers; please flag any items that need legal input)

Security notes (for MediGen security team):
- HIPAA: Redwood supports BAA — we can share the BAA template and sign as part of contracting.
- Data residency: Production inference and PHI are kept in us-east-1 by default; EU replication is opt-in and will require contract language and region configuration.
- Encryption: At-rest AES-256 with customer KMS for Dedicated/Private deployments; in-transit TLS1.2+.
- Audit artifacts: configuration snapshots, change logs, and a sample runbook for incident response will be available in the Trust portal folder.

If procurement wants an SFTP fallback, we can provision an expiring SFTP account and push the same artifacts there.

I’m attaching the signed bridge letter and the VSQ we discussed; please confirm receipt and whether you want the BAA so we can loop legal.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
